schema: Tradysquid 2.0 build backlog - Master Spec Section 19 (starting map, not a finish line). Section 20 requires appending newly discovered work to discovered_subphases at the end of every phase rather than silently expanding scope.

phases.name: Governance bootstrap / logging activation
phases.completion_criteria: governance/PROJECT_STATE.yaml(.json), PHASES.yaml(.json), ACTIVE_HANDOFF.yaml(.json), CHANGELOG.jsonl, OWNERSHIP.*, IMMUTABLE_RULES.* exist; a locking/concurrency mechanism is active; root/scoped agent instructions enforce read-before-write (Section 12). Tied to the commit that introduces it.
phases.completion_evidence: PRs #308-310 merged. governance/*.json created and kept in sync by ai_coordination.py's begin/checkpoint/finish (OneDrive lock stays the real exclusion mechanism; governance/ is its git-committed mirror). Verified: 13/13 coordination+governance tests, 68/68 tests/unit, 252/252 deployment gate, plus a real begin/checkpoint/finish cycle against a scratch control dir.

phases.name: Backup and freeze
phases.completion_criteria: Section 16 backups (raw SPY observations, raw option observations, daily manifests, data catalog) protected before any purge begins.
phases.completion_evidence: governance/PHASE1_BACKUP_MANIFEST.json - 2487 files, 1.7GB backed up to backups/phase1-freeze-<ts>/ with per-directory SHA-256 aggregates verified against a fresh re-hash. Live system stopped: 5 scheduled tasks disabled, watchdog-loop.ps1 killed, START-SUPERVISOR.cmd's restart loop exited via its own supervisor-stop.flag switch. Owner explicitly chose permanent stop (not resuming until Phase 3+).

phases.name: Final inventory
phases.completion_criteria: Every repository path classified PURGE / PRESERVE / EXTRACT-NEUTRALIZE / UNKNOWN per Section 2's survivor criteria, recorded before Phase 3 purge acts on it.

phases.name: Legacy purge
phases.completion_criteria: Section 2's purge list removed (old traders/strategies, entries/exits/configs, learned thresholds/models, champion/challenger/shadow/evolve/self-learning systems, journals/trades/positions/rankings/performance history, old research conclusions, trader-specific Discord state, dead-trader-only tests). No old trader becomes a template.

phases.name: Governance hardening
phases.completion_criteria: Schemas, write guards, ownership enforcement (Section 11's SHARED_CORE/SHARED_DATA/BLACKTIDE_ONLY/CLAUDE_ONLY/HUMAN_LEARNING_CENTER machine-readable ownership), stale-state detection, atomic state updates, concurrency prevention, scoped agent instructions, continuity/CI enforcement in place. Must not recreate competing copies of the Phase 0 state files.

phases.name: Shared factual market-data architecture / storage
phases.completion_criteria: Section 9's permanent daily SPY/0DTE collection running, Parquet/DuckDB storage per Section 9, daily data manifest with data-quality grades. Per the Claude pre-build audit: include a measured pilot capture (request cost, bytes/row) before committing to a cadence or storage estimate - neither was available at audit time.

phases.name: Neutral point-in-time backtest laboratory
phases.completion_criteria: Section 10's market.as_of(timestamp)/options.as_of(timestamp)/events.as_of(timestamp) interface built, Tier A/B/C evidence labeling enforced, formal backtests reproducible from recorded inputs.

phases.name: Shared runtime / API / cache / events
phases.completion_criteria: Section 8's shared API-budget architecture and priority scheme built; one shared factual market service ('one observation, many authorized readers').

phases.name: Neutral competition scorekeeper
phases.completion_criteria: Section 6's authoritative competition accounting built outside both private traders, consuming only immutable official trade records; neither trader can modify results.

phases.name: Discord rebuild
phases.completion_criteria: Section 14 synchronized surfaces/dashboards/scoreboards; Section 7 rivalry channel/personas/memory with the trading brain unable to read rivalry messages; Section 14 health/reconciliation states implemented.

phases.name: Learning Center shell
phases.completion_criteria: Section 15 category, #learning-index, and all 43 chapter channels (#01 through #43) exist as a shell with an indexing/search structure; content population is Phase 16.

phases.name: Independent bot ownership areas
phases.completion_criteria: bots/blacktide and bots/claude ownership areas exist per Section 11, with protected-write enforcement between them active before either trader is implemented.

phases.name: BLACKTIDE implementation
phases.completion_criteria: Codex-owned private trader built under Section 4's immutable competition rules, using only shared/approved resources per Section 3.

phases.name: Claude competitor implementation
phases.completion_criteria: Claude-owned private trader built under Section 4's immutable competition rules, using only shared/approved resources per Section 3.

phases.name: Full validation
phases.completion_criteria: Section 20's BUILD COMPLETE bar met: every known phase/subphase complete, no unresolved blocker, no orphaned integration, no stale/unowned Discord surface, project state and Git synchronized, required tests pass, and both Claude and Codex independently find no additional phase required.

phases.name: Competition launch
phases.completion_criteria: Both bots launched at Section 4's starting bankroll ($1,000) with 0 inherited trades.

phases.name: Full Learning Center population
phases.completion_criteria: Section 15's full 43-chapter curriculum authored (comprehensive original explanations, not skimmed), every lesson carries a stable ID, human Q&A can search and link directly to lessons.
